title: Source-first mechanical ornithopter interpretation

aspect_ratio.reading: The rounded Say full span is 7.4 ft and the original area paragraph gives 6.61 ft2; AR = 7.4^2 / 6.61.
aspect_ratio.excluded: The inconsistent 3.135 ft wing-length conversion is not used.

wrist_span_fraction.reading: Rounded wrist-to-wrist span 3.7 ft divided by rounded full span 7.4 ft.

wing_area_m2.basis: Supplied 14 m engineering span squared divided by the source-derived aspect ratio.

photographs.principle_used: Broad constant-chord inner arm, rounded and tapered outer hand wing, source-derived aspect ratio and wrist fraction.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: Faint marginal handwriting and the printed 3.135 ft conversion are inconsistent.
photographs.engineering_completion: The aircraft is scaled to 14 m and area is 14 squared divided by AR; the helper supplies the rounded ellipse and taper.

photographs.principle_used: Curved-plate section data are context rather than a reliable full-scale polar.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: Several axes, annotations and curve identities are ambiguous in the photographed multi-axis graph.
photographs.engineering_completion: The separate inner and outer coefficient tables are used and explicitly treated as illustrative assumptions.

photographs.principle_used: Candidate wing forces are evaluated against a desired cyclic trajectory; the intent is powered human-carrying mechanical flight.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: The note references missing appendices and does not specify a buildable force history.
photographs.engineering_completion: Local strip forces arise from actual linkage velocity; the comparison remains diagnostic and never prescribes flight.

photographs.principle_used: Straight flapping flight has cyclic lift and thrust and therefore small trajectory and speed undulations.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: Marginal pencil text is only partly legible.
photographs.engineering_completion: No altitude hold or direct thrust is added; the 16 kW engine and pilot are supplied assumptions, not Stanley specifications.

photographs.principle_used: Low-speed working stroke is longer, cruise timing is equal, candidate force is compared with required force, and wing/body motion is resonant.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: Dense marginal revisions near the trajectory paragraph cannot be read confidently.
photographs.engineering_completion: A fixed timing-bias law, supplied spring, distributed wing masses and drive inertia complete the mechanism.

photographs.principle_used: Resolve force from local wing motion; use fore/aft hand motion, recovery closing, elastic exchange and real pitching reaction about the common CG.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: Cross-outs and marginal words do not provide numerical linkage dimensions.
photographs.engineering_completion: Two rigid overlapping outer leaves, finite-difference Jacobians and the supplied coupled mass matrix provide a causal reduction.

photographs.principle_used: Recovery has reduced area and span and local incidence is adjusted; camber, incidence and thickness are distinct.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: The goshawk is an example and its camber percentages are not swan specifications.
photographs.engineering_completion: Independent twist and camber curves form curved geometry and section coefficients without importing goshawk dimensions.

photographs.principle_used: A 5 to 6 percent inner arm and thin curved slotted outer hand act differently on working and recovery strokes; conventional tail and rudder are compatible.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: No structural sizing or full control derivatives are given.
photographs.engineering_completion: Inner thickness is 5.5 percent, outer metadata 0.8 percent, and supplied tail/control coefficients close the model.

photographs.principle_used: Glide work begins with D times V; flapping adds aerodynamic, body-trajectory and wing-inertial terms; a spring transfers rather than creates energy.
photographs.unreadable_or_uncertain: Referenced appendices and revised equations are missing.
photographs.engineering_completion: Shaft work, aerodynamic dissipation, transmission/damping heat and control work are integrated; spring energy gives no net propulsion.

mass_statement.status: Favourable supplied engineering budget, not recovered from the notebooks.

limitations: Educational reduced model, not a validated human-flight design.
Engine, transmission, pilot, mass allocations, linkage curves and aerodynamic tables are engineering assumptions.
Section pitching moments, overlap-flow interference, wake memory, stall hysteresis, flexibility and fatigue are omitted.
Missing appendices, original section data and uncertain marginal revisions remain missing rather than invented.
